🎬 Fatherhood (2021)

Fatherhood follows Matt Logelin, a loving husband whose life changes forever when his wife, Liz, unexpectedly dies shortly after giving birth to their daughter, Maddy. Suddenly faced with the overwhelming responsibility of raising a newborn alone, Matt must navigate the emotional challenges of grief while learning how to become the father his daughter needs. Despite concerns from family members who question whether he can manage single parenthood, Matt is determined to raise Maddy himself. From sleepless nights and disastrous diaper changes to awkward parenting classes, unexpected emergencies, and emotional milestones, he discovers that fatherhood is far more complicated than he ever imagined. As Maddy grows older, Matt struggles to balance his demanding career, personal relationships, and the responsibility of providing a loving and stable home. With support from his closest friends and family, he gradually learns to embrace the unpredictable joys and challenges of parenting while honoring the memory of his late wife. Along the way, Matt faces difficult decisions about love, independence, and allowing himself to move forward without forgetting the past. Based on a true story, the film combines heartfelt comedy, emotional drama, and touching family moments while exploring grief, resilience, unconditional love, sacrifice, and the extraordinary bond between a father and daughter.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 49m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Paul Weitz

source_details.synopsis: Fatherhood is a 2021 American comedy-drama film directed by Paul Weitz from a screenplay by Weitz and Dana Stevens based on the 2011 memoir Two Kisses for Maddy: A Memoir of Loss and Love by Matthew Logelin. The film stars Kevin Hart, Alfre Woodard, Frankie R. Faison, Lil Rel Howery, DeWanda Wise, Anthony Carrigan, Melody Hurd, and Paul Reiser, and follows a new father who struggles to raise his daughter after the sudden death of his wife. Originally scheduled to be released in theaters by Sony Pictures Releasing, Fatherhood was sold to Netflix during the COVID-19 pandemic and was digitally released on June 18, 2021. The film received mixed reviews from critics.
